purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery record for an open-access peer-reviewed Munda food-environment study. Discovery metadata and article-level reuse terms are verified; participant-level data and cultural assertions remain subject to provenance, consent and MLHKP cultural-access review.

records.title: Indigenous food environment and dietary patterns of Munda community of Jharkhand, India
records.author: Suparna Ghosh-Jerath; Ridhima Kapoor; Naina Gandhi; Swati C. Nair; Aman Rastogi; Arpita Ghosh
records.notes: PubMed verifies BMC Nutrition volume 11, article 189, published 21 October 2025, PMID 41121309 and PMCID PMC12539013. The abstract reports a cross-sectional study in 201 Munda households in Jharkhand, with household surveys and food-frequency questionnaires in monsoon and winter. PMC full text further locates the study in eleven villages in Murhu and Torpa blocks of Khunti district. The record is canonicalized only to this source identity and study scope; no result is generalized to all Munda communities.
records.rights_note: Article is openly available through BMC/PMC; article-level licence/reuse terms do not override third-party-material credits, participant consent, underlying-data governance, dignity, or MLHKP cultural-access controls. Community validation is not inferred from research participation or ethics approval.
records.scope_note: Jharkhand Munda households; food environment and dietary patterns; cross-sectional research scope. Exact-locator evidence is bounded to the documented sample and setting.

canonicalization.decision: Exact DOI/title/authors match; registered once as a standalone audited MMSC identity and not double-counted in the discovery layer.
